description: Connect outside events and services without sharing their credentials. Receive authenticated events or send a body to a configured destination. Start with routes to see available names; post sends once and returns the response.
author: Serg Parf

post.help: Send one body to a configured outbound route, once. The reply contains the HTTP status and response text.

args.name: route
args.help: Configured outbound route name; a caller cannot supply a URL

args.name: body
args.help: UTF-8 body, unchanged; at most 262144 bytes and the route cap

routes.help: Find configured route names and whether they receive or send events. Credentials and URLs are not shown.
